reason: A better addresses the stated limitation by using a low-heat-input surface process that can preserve TC4 bulk properties while explicitly testing adhesion, homogeneity, residual damage, hardness, and wear under extreme-service conditions. B is more compositionally specific, but it reuses laser cladding—the identified problematic route—tests only ambient-to-moderate temperatures, makes a weakly supported ~70% prediction, and labels a largely Ti–Al–Cu–Ni composition as a refractory HEA.
